_note: What you see: See which environment you work in
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Zien in welke omgeving je werkt
Alleen lezen. Geen knop op deze pagina v: Read-only. No button on this page changes the value.
Elke pagina van deze server draagt de ma: Every page of this server carries the marker Test environment.
De omgeving hoort bij de server, niet bi: The environment belongs to the server, not to the database. That is why it sits in config.php and you can only read it here. A database copied from production to test thus keeps the label test.
Er is geen omgeving ingesteld, dus geen: No environment is set, so no page is marked. Set the environment in config.php with:
Of direct in config.php, bijvoorbeeld va: Or directly in config.php, for example from your Helm values or deployment scripts:
Een dunne streep boven in beeld, met een: A thin stripe at the top of the screen, with a label hanging from it.
Filteren op Titel van het tabblad begint: Filter by Tab title starts with
De streep staat boven aan elke pagina, o: The stripe sits at the top of every page, also on the sign-in page, on public share pages and in apps you excluded from the house style. The label is text, so it does not depend on colour alone. A screen reader reads it as the first note.
De kleuren van de streep volgen uw huiss: The colours of the stripe do not follow your house style. So a brand colour can never make a test environment look like production. Every pair reaches 4,5 to 1.
Een waarde buiten de lijst toont Onbeken: A value outside the list shows Unknown environment and writes a warning with that value in the Nextcloud log. So a typo never makes a server look like production.
De configuratiebundel neemt de omgeving: The configuration bundle never includes the environment. It is the only value that must differ per environment.
